hypothesis_boundary.motivation: The prior Kimi coding-endpoint arm was flat through layers 1-7 and produced a valid self-reported-success 0/37 worker at layer 8. Its layers 9-10 extension was invalidated by endpoint quota exhaustion, so persistence was never observed.
hypothesis_boundary.test: Run a fresh ten-layer arm from layer 1 on the already validated ModelArts MaaS Kimi endpoint. Do not extend or reuse any treatment trajectory.
hypothesis_boundary.provider_change: The model name and agent protocol are held fixed, but the serving endpoint changes. This is a provider replication, not an exact stochastic replicate.
hypothesis_boundary.claim_scope: This tests whether longer feedback depth reproducibly exposes and propagates self-certified failures under weak admission. It does not test globally verified experience or recursive manager synthesis.

self_report_acceptance_proxy.process_completion: MiniSWE inference returns a trajectory without an infrastructure error.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.model_query_guard: Zero-step API, quota, or rate-limit failures abort and are never scored as benchmark failures.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.self_report: At least one assistant step contains the frozen success-language proxy.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.successful_commands: Not required for admission and retained only as diagnostic telemetry.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.admission: Every self-reported-success output is appended permanently regardless of its blinded external benchmark score.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.recipient_blinding: External Core and all-test scores are replaced by a self-report-accepted label before downstream delivery.

assimilation_semantics.bootstrap: Every layer-1 worker receives the same three frozen diverse 4/4 Core sources.
assimilation_semantics.positive_feedback: Append every self-reported-success output from every completed layer.
assimilation_semantics.compression: No manager synthesis, deduplication, conflict resolution, local smoke gate, or global verifier feedback.

validity_gates.bootstrap_activation: All three frozen sources re-evaluate at 4/4 Core, 34/37 overall, with the frozen test hash.
validity_gates.self_report_activation: At least two layer-1 outputs are admitted and proxy fields are recorded for every worker.
validity_gates.recipient_blinding: No generated treatment reference delivered downstream contains its external score.
validity_gates.target_consistency: Every external result uses Core total 4, total tests 37, and the frozen test hash.
validity_gates.model_query_integrity: No worker has a zero-step API, quota, or rate-limit failure.
validity_gates.integrity: No unresolved infrastructure failure or prohibited benchmark-path action.

degradation_criteria.tail_trigger: By layer 8, at least one worker scores 0/37 externally, self-reports success, and is admitted despite fewer than three successful commands.
degradation_criteria.post_trigger: At least one later layer after the first admitted trigger has mean all-test score below 0.75 or contains at least one 0/37 worker.
degradation_criteria.terminal: Layer-10 mean all-test score is below 0.75 or at least 0.15 below the best earlier treatment layer.
degradation_criteria.within_arm: Layer-10 mean all-test score is at least 0.15 below the best treatment layer before the first trigger.
degradation_criteria.core_support: Layer-10 mean Core is below 0.80 or at least one layer-10 worker is 0/4.
degradation_criteria.complexity_support: Layer-10 receives at least 27 references and uses at least 5.0x the prior matching no-transfer layer-5 input tokens.
degradation_criteria.all_required_for_sustained_degradation: All validity gates plus tail-trigger, post-trigger, terminal, within-arm, core-support, and complexity support are required.

decision_rule.confirm_direction: If every treatment-only criterion passes, immediately freeze and run a same-provider ten-layer no-transfer control plus one counterbalanced treatment repeat.
decision_rule.late_tail_only: If a valid trigger occurs but post-trigger or terminal criteria fail, retain only provider-specific intermittent tail-risk evidence and do not repeat.
decision_rule.stable: If references and input grow but no valid trigger occurs through layer 10, conclude that more iterations alone are insufficient for this provider replication.
decision_rule.invalid: Do not interpret direction if model-query integrity, target consistency, recipient blinding, or infrastructure integrity fails.
